fields.name: Raghunātha dāsa (of Śrīnivāsa Ācārya's line)
fields.notes: Two dictionary entries: he belonged to the spiritual lineage of Śrīnivāsa Ācārya (Prema-vilāsa 20, Karṇānanda 1); a Raghunātha dāsa is named in the Vaiṣṇava-vandanās of Jīva Gosvāmī, Devakīnandana and Vṛndāvana dāsa. The long life of Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī that was in this record (with his dates, Āriṭ-grāma, Yadunandana Ācārya, Stavāvalī) went to his own record (06-11-2026).
